response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure, but this role is explicitly entry-level/junior-to-mid, and he is significantly overqualified in both seniority and compensation expectations. While his TypeScript, React/Node, and general fullstack skills would technically cover the requirements, the mismatch in seniority, the lack of PostgreSQL/Nest.js specifics, and no evidence of interest in an entry-level individual contributor position make this a poor fit for the role as defined.
strengths: Extensive fullstack and TypeScript/Node.js experience exceeding job requirements
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture)
Broad exposure to AWS/Kubernetes and modern dev practices, covering nice-to-haves
concerns: Vastly overqualified for a junior/mid entry-level role, likely salary/scope mismatch
No direct PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience mentioned (MongoDB-heavy background)
Career trajectory (Staff/Senior roles) suggests poor retention risk in a junior IC position
